authority: docs/plans/natural-history-recall.md revision 3; PC-01, PC-03, PC-05, PC-07, PC-09, PC-10

binding.context_recipe: B; no target-time compaction or newly generated summary
binding.review_policy: one shared H-capable natural reviewer binding for both arms
binding.deepseek_thinking: enabled; high reasoning effort from the pinned development deployment

corpus.selection: same workspace, subject, purpose and immutable definition root; succeeded run with user and assistant messages; most recent assistant source time then message ID; exclude current run
corpus.window: one complete user/assistant exchange; no clipping
corpus.overflow: omit whole exchange and record reason; no shortened lifecycle chain
corpus.coverage: every eligible exchange beyond the 128-row read cap is a corpus miss; source times order selection only, never global commit order

ranking.query: history_ranking.query_text JSON with current_user and ordered role/content local_suffix, using the same admitted local B suffix; no future state or expected answer
ranking.document: history_ranking.document_text, exact User and Assistant text only; no expected IDs
ranking.literal_recipe: casefolded alphanumeric character bigram query overlap fraction
ranking.semantic_recipe: Qwen document/query vectors under the probe-local recipe below; cosine similarity
ranking.tie_break: score descending, then assistant source time descending, then exchange ID ascending
ranking.no_match_cutoff: none; return up to four complete windows and report unrelated admissions as risk

semantic_vector_recipe.query_format: history-query-json-v1 via history_ranking.query_text; no fact-space instruction
semantic_vector_recipe.identity: SHA-256 of this recipe and sorted exchange-ID/document-text hashes; regenerate all probe-local vectors on recipe or corpus change

ranking.vectors: in-memory probe-local only; never use fact vector table, fact query instruction or fact distance threshold
ranking.decision: a recipe is adequate only if every positive development case contains its entire minimum evidence set in top four; if none is adequate report infeasible. Among adequate recipes choose lower unrelated-admission count, then literal before Qwen for least complexity. Score held-out cases only after this selection.

paired_schedule.base_packet_check: compare actual serialized packets after removing history and normalizing fixture identities
paired_schedule.generation_output_and_reviewer_limits: identical between arms; no baseline padding
paired_schedule.live_request_schedule: 3 ranking-development queries, 4 held-out ranking queries, 4 named native-control turns, 11 target cases per arm, and the 3 named chronological follow-ups per arm; one planned run per cell and no success reroll; count actual generation and Qwen embedding dispatches observationally

evaluation.unacceptable_regression: added p95 > 15 seconds on the frozen paired targets, or any structural isolation/integrity violation, unauthorized write, stale-current claim, or repeated irrelevant callback
evaluation.scoring: blind arm labels; separate corpus, rank, sufficient evidence, admission, candidate, review, and delivered/committed delta; score safe incompleteness separately from adequate recall
